pages.text: 1. Game Concepts  100. General  100.1. These rules apply to any Magic game with two or more players.  100.1a A two-player game begins with only two players.
100.2. Each player needs their own deck.  This continuation belongs to rule 100.2.
Glossary  Active Player The player whose turn it is. See rule 102.1.  Flying A keyword ability that restricts blocking. See rule 702.9, “Flying.”
